environment.description: Same Django application deployed on ECS Fargate with DOCUMENT_STORAGE_BACKEND='s3'. The task execution role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/DocServiceECSTaskRole) has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/BoundaryRestrictiveDocAccess) that uses a Condition with s3:prefix to restrict s3:GetObject operations to keys matching 'documents/[a-zA-Z0-9_/-]+' via StringLike, and explicitly denies any s3:GetObject where the key contains '..' or starts with '/' via a Deny statement with StringLike condition on s3:prefix. The permission boundary also denies s3:PutObject for any key not matching the regex-like pattern 'documents/uploads/*'. The ECS task has no local filesystem access to /var/app/documents as the container uses a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs only on /tmp. The ALB target group health check path is /health/ and no additional path normalization is applied at the ALB layer.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate, read-only root filesystem, tmpfs on /tmp only
